{{Aquarius}}
Aquarius 22 is the 78th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 22nd day of Aquarius, and it is a Monday. It corresponds to ISO week 12, weekday 1.

Its informal Japanese name is 3宮22日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 78|Chapter 78]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152098}}.
